collection: Gruta dos Elos — separação visual v3

assets.name: Leito de dobras
assets.brief: Directly overhead seamless walkable cave floor. Very dark desaturated blue-grey slate base around #344453. Almost uniform matte solid colour, only TWO very faint thin interrupted fold lines over the entire image, adjacent planes differ by under ten percent brightness. Flat 2D. NO cream veins, no orange junctions, no white stripes, no rocks, no slabs or paving grout, no diamond grids. Quiet ground under brighter objects.

assets.name: Terra de papel
assets.brief: Directly overhead seamless walkable cave dirt path. Muted medium-dark dusty earthen brown #7C624C, broad flat low-contrast matte fill, a few very small shallow brown flecks. Flat 2D. No stones, no long lines, no decorative motifs, no paper shapes, no bright flecks. Slightly lighter than a dark slate floor, darker than sandstone objects.

assets.name: Pedra de maré
assets.brief: Directly overhead seamless wet cave floor. Very dark desaturated blue petrol #293E49, broad solid flat matte shapes, only two extremely faint shorter bluish wet streaks. Flat 2D. No cream, no bright cyan lines, no white veins, no orange mineral junctions. Almost empty low-contrast ground, no paving or raised rocks.

assets.name: Lascas de vela
assets.brief: Directly overhead seamless cave gravel path. Medium-dark muted charcoal taupe #69635A base, a few tiny darker flat chips scattered irregularly. Flat 2D. No big rocks, no cream-white flecks, no diamond pattern, no cracks or large shapes, quiet walkable ground.

assets.name: Dobras de calcário
assets.brief: Straight-on seamless flat cave wall material. Broad large simple folded limestone planes in muted dusty violet grey #81788D, one lighter muted grey face and one shadow face. Few dark plum/navy fold lines, tiny ochre line junction only at one place. Flat 2D, no cream ribbons or bright veins, no regular bricks. Mid-value wall brighter than a dark slate floor, less bright than foreground objects.

assets.name: Ardósia do vento
assets.brief: Straight-on seamless flat cave wall material. Broad large angular slate folds in muted purple-blue grey #6D6981 and #868297, with sparse dark ink lines. Very restrained low contrast, no giant cream bands or orange ribbons, no regular masonry, no many bevel facets. Flat 2D graphic cut-paper geological planes.

assets.name: Parede de ecos
assets.brief: Straight-on seamless damp cave wall material. Broad folded rock planes in muted mauve blue-grey #696B83 and #85869B, very few subdued teal fissures, no cream veins or bright seams. Three flat solid areas per material, mid-value wall clearly brighter than dark wet floor, no gradient or 3D rendering.

assets.name: Veios de elo
assets.brief: Straight-on seamless cave wall material. Broad muted purple-grey folded slate planes, medium value #797588, with one small thin restrained ochre mineral seam and one small knot-shaped junction. Flat 2D outline and solid fills. No bright cream ribbons, no regular diamond pattern, no photoreal texture, no dense runes.

assets.name: Pedras dobradas
assets.brief: One low compact pile of three broad natural slate fragments shaped like folded paper fans, irregular simple silhouette, cream top planes and petrol blue shadow planes, one small terracotta mineral seam, NOT literal paper objects. Strong clean navy contour, no many tiny rocks.
assets.paletteRevision: Neutral medium-light pewter grey rock, pale warm grey lit planes, muted charcoal slate shadow planes. Reduce blue and cream to minor accents. This low rock must be distinctly lighter than a dark blue floor.

assets.name: Nós de pedra
assets.brief: One squat cave mineral growth, two naturally fused looped bands of cream and blue slate creating a knot-like silhouette with a small open hole, tiny broken stone shards at its roots. Looks like geological knot sculpture, no literal rope, no face, not a spool prop.
assets.paletteRevision: Warm sandstone ochre knot rock, pale sandy yellow lit planes, muted warm mauve brown shadows. Tiny terracotta mineral junction. No blue stone body.

assets.name: Agulha do vento
assets.brief: One tall thick limestone stalagmite with two small side spikes at its base, broad angular tapered silhouette, grey slate facets and muted ivory edge.
assets.paletteRevision: Warm pale limestone needle, off-white ivory main lit plane, muted taupe-grey other plane, restrained ochre mineral knot. No blue body. The silhouette is a bright slim landmark against a dark floor.

assets.name: Coluna de rabiolas
assets.brief: One cave column formed from broad slate geological folds that flare into three alternating bow-shaped ledges, suggesting the rhythm of kite-tail bows. A stout tapered central support and wide root. Muted petrol blue, cream light planes, two terracotta strata. It must read as stone shaped by wind, not a stack of actual kites. Very few large shapes.
assets.paletteRevision: Warm bone-cream column, broad sandy cream lit ledges and stem, muted dusty brown/mauve shadow plane, tiny terracotta accents. No blue stone body. Make the structural stem readable between bow-like ledges.

assets.name: Ecos de Azulão
assets.brief: One low cave mineral fan formation with one large asymmetric diamond-shaped turquoise stone plate and two wing-like folded mineral plates, joined by a small cream mineral knot at the base. Its broad silhouette echoes a living bird kite without an animal head or face. Flat teal and cream planes with navy linework, minimal bright edges. No generic quartz spikes.
assets.paletteRevision: Saturated turquoise and cyan mineral fan, pale mint lit planes and deep teal shadow planes. Cream only a tiny knot accent. No huge cream patches or dark blue body. Preserve the two wing-like side plates.

assets.name: Brasa de Carcará
assets.brief: One warm amber cave mineral fan shaped like three layered angular feather-sail plates, one off-centre diamond joint and a tiny bent ribbon-like stone spur at base. Suggest the spirit of Carcará through feather-shaped geological planes, no animal face or eyes, not a literal bird. Flat ochre terracotta cream and navy outline, no quartz crystal spikes, no lighting halo.
assets.paletteRevision: Rich golden amber and terracotta mineral feather fan, pale golden-yellow lit edge, burnt orange shadow plane. Cream only tiny bright edge. No grey-blue body. Clearly warm and bright.

assets.name: Flores de linha
assets.brief: One small low cave flora cluster with five curled ink-blue slender stems and broad folded diamond-shaped cream and turquoise caps, one tiny ochre stem-joint. Plantlike mushrooms whose caps echo folded kite paper. Asymmetric readable silhouette, only five large caps, strong navy lines and solid fill, no tiny speckled texture or halo.
assets.paletteRevision: Fresh muted mint-green folded caps with pale leaf-green lit planes, dark muted moss stems with one pale slim edge, tiny ochre joint. No blue body or large cream patches. Preserve all five caps and stems.

assets.name: Portal do elo
assets.brief: One isolated broad cave arch opening formed from LARGE folded-looking blue slate rock planes, cream edge planes, a simple off-centre diamond keystone with a terracotta mineral knot at its base and two thin line-shaped mineral seams across the arch shoulders. Large empty dark tunnel, open entrance base, no stairs or plinth. Kite-inspired natural geology, not a constructed ornate castle gate. Only a few large graphic forms.
assets.paletteRevision: Medium-light dusty mauve-grey stone arch, lighter warm grey planes, thin bone-ivory inner lip only, terracotta keystone joint. The tunnel interior is nearly black navy with no detail or lit floor. Grey arch must separate from medium-purple cave walls. Preserve broad passage.

assets.name: Água de linhas
assets.brief: Flat directly overhead cave pool water, deep muted navy-petrol base with only a few broad broken cyan curling ripple ribbons, line rhythm reminiscent of kite strings and wind strokes, 3 solid colours, huge calm negative space. NO foam field, no caustic network, no realistic shading, no dense pattern.

assets.name: Queda de fitas
assets.brief: Flat straight-on falling cave water texture, long mostly straight vertical cream-white and muted turquoise ribbons on a petrol-blue base. A few slightly tapering angular ribbons echo kite tails, but remain liquid water, no literal paper bows. Very broad clean 2D ink shapes, three colours, no droplets or bubbles, no realistic shading. No top lip or bottom splash.
